design_context.goal: Evolve a general-purpose agent harness and loop system, lightly specialized for building stronger legal UCI chess engines on the existing ChessBench.
design_context.single_causal_factor: Directionality of causal-information flow after the sole executable component is handed to its downstream consumer
design_context.emergent_capability: Open and close exactly one consumer-originated causal query before final engine construction, translating the original executable component's producer-side semantics into one anchor-grounded consumer-ready binding without changing the component's causal target or creating another candidate.
design_context.topology: one foundry realizes and seam-rehearses the sole non-engine component; one prospective consumer compiles an anchor-grounded binding and conditionally opens exactly one causal query; one resolver closes that query or canonicalizes the grounded no-query handoff for the same component; one final producer grafts once and emits the only engine

supported_basis: R37/internal r0018 promoted 2W/0L/1T with median Elo delta +57.053 by making one strength-bearing component executable before whole-engine coupling.
R38/internal r0019 promoted 2W/1L with median Elo delta +14.521 by retaining that family and rehearsing the same component at an anchor-derived seam.
The champion's own bounded risks acknowledge that surrogate evidence may omit deep recursive, timing, or global-state behavior that becomes visible only to the downstream integrator.
evidence_interpretation.r39_bounded_result: R39/internal r0020 was a valid 0W/1L/2T batch with candidate and incumbent median Elo both -204.753 and no invalid decision arms; it consumed the second local round and moved search to emergent exploration.
evidence_interpretation.allowed_inference: A consumer-triggered, single-query return path is a genuinely new loop action worth testing because it operates after the supported component handoff and changes information-flow direction rather than refining upstream gap selection or seam fidelity.
evidence_interpretation.forbidden_inference: The evidence does not identify a universally strong chess mechanism, benchmark position, opening, evaluator detail, engine parameter, or guarantee that clarification improves playing strength.

history_scan.scope: all other workspace normalized-plan.json and loop-structure.json metadata, including official rounds, champions, manual staging history, aborted rounds, and savepoints, plus exact-text search across experiments/chess-tier5-clean

output.emergent_capability: Open and close exactly one consumer-originated causal query before final engine construction, translating the original executable component's producer-side semantics into one anchor-grounded consumer-ready binding without changing the component's causal target or creating another candidate.

emergent_extension.preserves_champion_family: Exactly one strength-bearing non-engine component still becomes executable before any complete candidate engine, is rehearsed through an anchor-derived seam, and is grafted once into the supplied anchor by the only engine producer.
emergent_extension.one_factor_difference: Only the directionality of post-handoff causal information changes: a previously sealed one-way producer-to-consumer edge gains one trigger-bounded consumer query and resolution return edge.
emergent_extension.trigger_based_state_transition: SEALED_HANDOFF with one consumer-critical UNKNOWN becomes QUERY_OPEN and then RESOLVED_DIALOGUE before engine construction; NO_QUERY remains an explicit grounded forward path.
emergent_extension.new_observable_behavior: The consumer can make one downstream uncertainty causally alter the pre-engine information state and receive an executable answer tied to the original component.
emergent_extension.not_local_seam_or_gap_refinement: The plan retains the champion's seam rehearsal and does not add or strengthen a gap witness; it changes control-flow reachability and feedback direction after handoff.
emergent_extension.not_topology_cosmetic: The query and resolution artifacts can exist only after consumer-context grounding and causally constrain the final producer; they are not renamed packets, repeated samples, reviews, gates, or decorative stages.
